question: Lieutenant General Gurmit Singh was appointed as the Governor of ______ in September 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Uttarakhand.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Gurmit Singh was born on** 1 February 1956 in Amritsar Punjab**.
 
• Gurmit Singh is a** retired army office**r.
 
• He charged the honourable governor on **September 15, 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• There shall be a Governor for each State** Articles 153.**
 
• Governor of States** (Article 152-162**)
 
• **155 Article** Appointment of Governor.
 
• **156 Article **Term of office of Governor.
 
• The Governor of the state is** appointed by the President of India.**
 
• The term of time is** 5 years.**
